entities.summary: Vladimir Mikhailovich Denisov, also spelled sometimes as Uladzimir Mikhailavich Dzianisau is a Belarusian former professional ice hockey defenseman. He last played for SaiPa of the Finnish Liiga. He participated at the 2010 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Belarusian national team.
